limitations: Single short samples from multiple browser batches; not a same-run continuous A/B comparison
First horizontal walk windows contain idle at their ends and are rejected for walking cost
Second original-walk wrapper has an artificial distance rejection; raw valid walking observations are retained and recovered without rerun
Different route for valid walking versus the valid earlier seated samples; all cameras room, viewport1440x1000,DPR1,speed1.05,rate1
RAF and render-start intervals are wall intervals, not isolated main-loop CPU duration
renderSubmitCPUms is CPU wall time inside renderer.render, not GPU duration
Measured appearance.updateDynamics includes proxy sync, official solver and replacement material updates; original body/cloth/native VRM solver CPU was not separated
Timer resolution/instrumentation, sequential order, browser scheduling and thermal state not controlled
No forced GC; JS heap is an observation, not a leak proof
Style restore retains hidden per-actor cache; explicit appearance disposal was separately observed only once
Resource counters include whole room/render passes and do not measure GPU bytes
WMI AdapterRAM is a legacy32-bit field, not reliable4090VRAM capacity; OS Caption suffix decoding is corrupted, numeric OS version/build retained
No ordinary-PC, long-duration, visual/contact or universal-hair performance acceptance
